description: Source code for handling combined diffs in a version control system, including path comparison, diff generation, and merge handling.

classes.name: combine_diff_path
classes.description: Represents a combined diff path with multiple parent versions.

classes.name: lline
classes.description: Represents a line lost from a parent during diff processing.

classes.name: plost
classes.description: Tracks lines lost from a parent before coalescing.

classes.name: sline
classes.description: Represents a line surviving in the merge result, including lost lines and flags.

classes.name: combine_diff_state
classes.description: Maintains state during diff combination, including line numbers and line data.

methods.name: compare_paths
methods.description: Compares two file paths considering directory modes.

methods.name: filename_changed
methods.description: Checks if a filename change indicator ('R' or 'C') is present.

methods.name: intersect_paths
methods.description: Finds intersection of paths among multiple diff paths.

methods.name: match_string_spaces
methods.description: Compares two lines with whitespace considerations.

methods.name: coalesce_lines
methods.description: Coalesces new lines into a base list using LCS algorithm.

methods.name: grab_blob
methods.description: Retrieves file content or subproject info based on object id and mode.

methods.name: append_lost
methods.description: Appends a lost line to a line list.

methods.name: combine_diff
methods.description: Generates combined diff output for a given parent version.

methods.name: show_combined_header
methods.description: Displays header information for combined diffs.

methods.name: show_patch_diff
methods.description: Displays patch-style diff for combined diff paths.

methods.name: show_raw_diff
methods.description: Displays raw diff output for combined diff paths.

methods.name: show_combined_diff
methods.description: Main function to display combined diff for a path.

methods.name: diff_tree_combined
methods.description: Computes combined diff paths across multiple parent commits.

methods.name: diff_tree_combined_merge
methods.description: Handles diff for a merge commit with multiple parents.

methods.name: combine_diff_path_new
methods.description: Creates a new combined diff path object.
